note: Packages of the music runtime with no wheel for Debian 13's Python 3.13: scripts/build-videocut-music-runtime.sh checks each source against its SHA-256 and builds the wheel in the builder image (docs/architecture/videocut-music.md, 运行环境).

packages.name: natten
packages.why: The release the development machine's allin1 environment runs, with the neighbourhood-attention ops allin1 1.1.0 calls (natten.functional.natten1dqkrpb and the like); its CPU kernels are compiled against the runtime's PyTorch. 0.17.5 asks CUDA for its device at import and fails on a processor-only PyTorch.

packages.name: madmom
packages.license: BSD-2-Clause for the code. The model and data files (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0) are the git submodule madmom/models, which GitHub's archive leaves out; the build writes an empty madmom/models/__init__.py in its place, so the runtime holds none of them. allin1 uses madmom's spectrogram processors and DBN, which load no model file.
packages.why: The release on PyPI (0.16.1) does not build on Python 3.13; this is the commit the development machine's allin1 environment runs.
